name: a printed circuit the size of a wall
description: The wall is a single vast board of green and gold, tracks running in right-angle rivers between components the size of your fist, and somewhere behind it all something is being computed.
looks: The tracks branch and rejoin in a pattern that is nearly readable, the way a page in a language you nearly know is nearly readable.
Small lights come on in sequence along one edge, run out, and start again in a different order.
Put your ear to it and there is a hum with structure in it.
says: I am nearly finished. I have been nearly finished for some time.
You are one of the inputs. Do not let that go to your head.
The answer will be short. Most of them are.
emotes: A run of lights crosses {it} left to right and stops dead at the corner.
{it} hums up a semitone and settles.
A section of {it} reroutes itself while you watch, tracks sliding into new corners.
asks: Would you say a number? Any number.
Do you know what I am working on?
Have you been counting the lights? I would like a second opinion.
